en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_JS_ENABLED: Runs imported DM Note-style JavaScript plugins inside a limited Jint sandbox. Only load plugins you trust.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_JS_IMPORT: Import a .js or .mjs plugin written for DM Note's declarative defineElement API.
en-US.DESC_KVI_REBIND: Click, then press the new key for this element. Esc cancels.
en-US.DESC_KVI_GHOST_SET: Click, then press a second key that lights this element up without counting as a press. Esc cancels.
en-US.DESC_KVI_COUNTINTOTAL: Include this key's presses in the Total stat. Turn it off for foot keys and anything you do not want counted.
en-US.DESC_KVI_IDLE_TRANSPARENT: Hide the background while the key is up, keeping its border and label. The background colour is remembered.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ACTIVE_TRANSPARENT: Hide the background while the key is held, keeping its border and label.
en-US.DESC_KVI_NOTE_GRADIENT: Fade the rain between two colours from top to bottom instead of using one flat colour.
en-US.DESC_KVI_NOTE_GLOW_GRADIENT: Fade the glow between two colours from top to bottom instead of using one flat colour.
en-US.DESC_KVI_NOTE_AUTOY: Start this element's rain at the top of the shared track rather than at the element itself. Turn it off to give a lower element a shorter track of its own.
en-US.DESC_KVI_COUNTER_ENABLED: Draw this element's press count. The Key Viewer's own Show Counter setting still has to be on.
en-US.DESC_KVI_COUNTER_PERKEYKPS: This key's counter shows its own presses-per-second instead of its running total. The total is still counted.
en-US.KVI_COUNTER_MODE_HINT: Center draws the label and count as one line; Between pushes them to opposite edges.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ADD_KEY: Drop a new key in the middle of the view, then bind it in the panel beside it.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ADD_STAT: Drop a new readout in the middle of the view. Pick which number it shows in the panel beside it.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ADD: Add a key, a readout or a KPS graph to the middle of the view.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ADD_GRAPH: Drop a new KPS graph in the middle of the view.
en-US.DESC_KVI_DUPLICATE: Copy the selected elements, offset slightly from the originals.
en-US.DESC_KVI_Z_FRONT: Draw the selected elements one step in front of the ones they overlap.
en-US.DESC_KVI_Z_BACK: Draw the selected elements one step behind the ones they overlap.
en-US.DESC_KVI_DELETE: Remove the selected elements from this tab.
en-US.DESC_KVI_REDO: Step forward again through the edits you undid.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ZOOM_OUT: Zoom the view out. The - key over the canvas does the same.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ZOOM_IN: Zoom the view in. The + key over the canvas does the same.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ZOOM_RESET: Back to actual size, at the top-left of the layout. The 0 key does the same.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ZOOM_FIT: Frame every element on this tab. Use this if you have panned the layout out of sight.
en-US.KVI_TOOLBAR_HINT: Scroll to pan, or drag with the middle or right mouse button. Press + and - to zoom, 0 for actual size. Arrow keys nudge, Delete removes.
en-US.DESC_KVI_HIDDEN: Keep the selected elements in the layout but stop drawing them in game. Hidden elements dim on the canvas and cannot be clicked.
en-US.KVI_EMPTY: Select an element on the canvas to edit it. Drag a box around several to edit them together.
en-US.DESC_KVI_COUNTER_SHOWWHILEPRESSING: Keep the counter on screen while the key is held. Off hides it for as long as the key is down and brings it back on release; its space is still reserved, so the label does not move.
en-US.DESC_KVI_LABEL_ENABLED: Draw this element's label. With it off the counter spreads over the whole box, and the box, border and rain are untouched.
